feature: Historical McIntyre Lake / modern MacIntyre reservoir
reason: Whole-basin outlines do not share a stable definition: the source shows a smaller eastern basin with a western inlet and southwest mill/outlet, whereas original current water lines outline a wider western extent. The 2026 environmental assessment documents MacIntyre as a reservoir with embankment dam and spillway, corroborating water-level/impoundment concerns. No centroid or shoreline control was adopted.

external_evidence.title: Little River Pumping and Transmission System Project Environmental Assessment Registration
external_evidence.support: Documents MacIntyre Lake as a reservoir formed by an embankment dam and spillway; identifies Barberton Road and Highway 4 as bordering features.
external_evidence.limitation: Does not itself establish the date or exact magnitude of shoreline change from the Church scan.
